descriptions.text: Climb any surface with long mechanical arms. Watch your grip: when it runs out, you fall.
The original obby. Jump from checkpoint to checkpoint, grab coins and open chests.
Ride your skateboard through obstacle stages. Ollie, grind rails and pull off tricks.
Play as a monkey and escape through three worlds of traps. Level up, unlock effects and rebirth.
Jump across giant keyboards and past presses and grinders. Level up to reach harder stages.
Climb the tower stage by stage over pop-its, keycaps and conveyor belts. Power-ups help you reach the top.
Climb a slimy tower stage by stage and dodge the moving obstacles on your way up.
Get past troll traps like cannons, glass floors and math doors. Slap other players to gain aura.
Welcome to IQ Test Tower! Solve test after test to ride higher. Stuck? You can skip a test.
Break objects to earn XP, level up to open new doors, and take on the boss.
Ride your bike through obstacle stages, collect coins and buy new bikes.
Ready up and compete in multiplayer games like Team Battle, Paint War and Glass Bridge.
Ride your cart through chapters of bombs, cannons and flamethrowers. Buy new carts in the store.
Use your ladder to reach ledges you can't jump to. Collect coins and open chests along the way.
Round-based multiplayer battle. Dodge bombs, spike balls and slime, and be the last one standing.
Fly your plane past birds, meteors and bombs. Collect coins and buy new planes.
Steer your boat down the river past mines, piranhas and flamethrowers. Buy new boats with coins.
Drive through obstacle stages, collect coins and unlock new cars.
Roll through the stages as a ball, use jump platforms and avoid deadly objects.
